messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 request latency spike detected across router clusters in eu-west-2 and us-west-2. p95 up 3x, p99 up 6x over baseline — streaming stalls observed. Auto-page to #oncall.

mia (oncall): acked. getting bridge up. looking at graphs now — which routes are noisy? :eyes:

raj (eng-runtime): seeing a pattern: loadbalancer routing policy rollout at 1708126000 changed weight calc for sticky-evictor. many keys now pinned to a few shards (hot partitions). logs show repeated rehash attempts -> increased tail.

sophia (eng-sre): confirm from heatmap: hotkeys clustered in eu-west-2 primary AZ, cross-zone fallback traffic hitting a small set of routers. KV cache miss rate spiked ~40%.

mia (oncall): impact? are customers seeing timeouts or streaming stalls? jess, any CS reports?

jess (support): one enterprise account reported streaming stalls and partial responses ~10:00 UTC, raised ticket INC-7841. several internal synthetic checks for chat-streaming show stalls at p99. Customers affected intermittently.

alejandro (product): are there any model changes or rollouts that coincided? we had a dedicated capacity customer migration earlier to eu-west-2 but shouldn't affect routing.

raj (eng-runtime): no model changes. deploy-bot shows a config push to router-policy-service at 1708125900 with new weight formula (rollout 30%). suspected regression in tie-breaker leading to weight collapse for low-entropy keys.

mia (oncall): can we roll back that policy immediately or adjust weights? what's the fastest mitigation to reduce tail?

raj (eng-runtime): quick mitigations: 1) disable new weight calc (rollback) 2) throttle sticky affinity for hotkeys 3) route weight override to spread traffic. I can issue a forced rollback but want agreement.

sophia (eng-sre): also possible: enable eager-fallback on affected routers to route to next-best pool instead of overloading primary. That reduces latency but may increase cost.

mia (oncall): do it. raj, please rollback policy and put a temporary route weight override for eu-west-2. sophia, enable eager-fallback for streaming routes. i'll coordinate with deploy-bot to trigger rollback.

raj (eng-runtime): working on rollback now. command: 
```
# rollback router-policy-service to v1.14.2
kubectl -n router-policy rollout undo deploy/router-policy-service --to-revision=1
```
Doing it in canary groups to avoid blipping other regions.

deploy-bot: deploy started: router-policy-service rollback -> v1.14.2 (canary group 1). CI checks passed.

mia (oncall): monitoring. sophia, ready to toggle eager-fallback?

sophia (eng-sre): toggling: 
```
POST /internal/routers/euw2/config
{ "eager_fallback": true, "routes": ["/v1/stream", "/v1/chat"] }
```
Applied to eu-west-2 primary pool.

raj (eng-runtime): rollback canary looks good so far. metrics starting to trend down — p95 dropping. pushing rollback to canary group 2.

mia (oncall): good. any errors during rollback?

deploy-bot: canary group 2 rollback complete. No regressions.

jess (support): customer ticket updated: temporary mitigation applied by infra team. requesting status link for customer updates.

alejandro (product): please add a short blurb I can share: root cause = router weight calc regression -> hot partitioning -> tail latency and streaming stalls; mitigation = policy rollback + eager-fallback + route weight overrides.

mia (oncall): noted. generating short incident summary for public comms after we stabilize.

sophia (eng-sre): telemetry: p99 reduced from 1.8s -> 450ms in eu-west-2 after both mitigations. KV cache miss rate down 22%. streaming stall alerts cleared for most synthetics.

raj (eng-runtime): follow-up: found a corner-case in the weight calc where keys with low entropy get assigned near-zero variance in the softmax numerator, collapsing to same shard. patch in review to add epsilon smoothing.

mia (oncall): can we hotfix or should we keep rollback?

raj (eng-runtime): I'd prefer to keep rollback until patch is fully tested. patch PR: https://git.internal/r/router-policy/pulls/489. Tests include synthetic hotkey loads.

jess (support): customers notified: updated INC-7841 with mitigation steps and ETA for permanent fix.

alejandro (product): any impact on SLA credit? p99 SLO breached briefly; will need to calculate window and affected accounts. please collect start/end and affected routes.

mia (oncall): action items: 
- raj: keep rollback in place, follow PR.
- sophia: keep eager-fallback enabled for eu-west-2 and monitor cost impact.
- jess: compile list of affected customers and incidents.
- mia: write initial post-incident note and handoff at 03:00 UTC.

sophia (eng-sre): enabling a short-term autoscale bump for eu-west-2 router pool to reduce queuing while we monitor.

raj (eng-runtime): note to self: add metrics to alert on weight entropy and sticky-pinning ratio. current alerts didn't capture this pattern.

mia (oncall): bridging to ENG-RUNTIME for deeper triage. cc @raj. bridge: https://call.redwood/bridges/INC-7841

raj (eng-runtime): on bridge. also capturing related logs: 
```
[2024-02-16T10:05:12Z] route-eval: key_hash=0x01ab3f, entropy_metric=0.002, assigned_shard=shard-7
[2024-02-16T10:05:13Z] rehash_attempt: key_hash=0x01ab3f, prev_shard=shard-3, new_shard=shard-7
```
These show repeated reassigns.

mia (oncall): planning handoff in 15m to night oncall if things stable. please add a short status snippet for next shift.

sophia (eng-sre): status snippet: 
- Incident: router routing-policy regression causing hot-partitioning and tail latency in eu-west-2/us-west-2.
- Mitigation: rolled back router-policy to v1.14.2; enabled eager-fallback; temporary route weight overrides and autoscale bump.
- Current: latency trending to normal, p99 reduced ~75%. monitoring for recurrence.
- Next steps: deploy patch with epsilon smoothing; add alerts for weight entropy; run chaos test.

mia (oncall): copy. adding to handoff doc and will ping night oncall.

raj (eng-runtime): FYI: stacktrace from policy eval found null-branch where denominator could be 0 for low-variance keys. PR fixes with epsilon and adds tests.

sophia (eng-sre): cost note: eager-fallback increased cross-zone calls by ~8% during peak — watch billing.

jess (support): I've sent customer-facing update. one customer replied they're seeing degraded but acceptable performance; asking for timeline for permanent fix.

alejandro (product): good. let's target patch release in next 24-48h with a tested rollout plan. include canary checks for weight entropy.

mia (oncall): wrapping up: leaving rollback and eager-fallback in place. monitoring for 1 hour before de-escalating. handing over to night oncall @lucas. handoff note: see bridge + handoff snippet above.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: Mitigated -> Monitoring. Bridge closed at 1708130350.

lucas (night-oncall): acked. I'll watch p95/p99 and queue any regressions. if spike returns, escalate to ENG-RUNTIME immediately.

mia (oncall): thanks all — great quick coordination. postmortem to follow once PR is merged and rollout complete. :thumbsup:
